audience: teams that run email newsletters and manage subscribers with Stibee

useCases.title: Count subscribers and check their status
useCases.text: Count the subscribers of an address book, optionally by status. List subscribers to see their custom fields and dates.

useCases.title: Check how a subscriber reacted to recent emails
useCases.text: List recent emails and read the open and click rates of up to 10 of them. Open the activity log of one email to see its events.

useCases.title: Add a new customer to a group
useCases.text: Add one subscriber to an address book, then add that subscriber to a group. Set the update flag to change an existing subscriber.

useCases.title: Import a list of subscribers in bulk
useCases.text: Add up to 1000 subscribers in one call. The result lists the created, updated and failed emails.

useCases.title: Remove a subscriber from a group
useCases.text: Take a subscriber out of a group. The subscriber stays in the address book.
